Total body mass per species (all 43 rows used): Adelie 50,825 g, Chinstrap 39,700 g, Gentoo 103,500 g.

Problems found and fixed:
1. species had 9 distinct labels instead of the 3 allowed ones — trailing spaces ("Gentoo ", "Chinstrap "), a case variant ("adelie"), and misspellings ("Adeile", "Chinstarp", "Gentto"). Merged all 7 affected cells into Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo with normalize_labels (approved). Without this the totals would have been split across 9 groups.
2. body_mass_g was stored as text, with 3 values written with thousands separators ("3,750", "3,000", "4,725"). Cast to numbers (low risk, no values lost). All values are within the rules range 2500–6500 g.
3. No exact duplicate rows.

Caveats: flipper_length_mm has one negative value (-200) that breaks the rules range (170–235), but that column is not used by this question, so I left it untouched — worth fixing if you later analyze flipper length. sex has 2 missing values, which the rules say mean "unknown" and should not be guessed; also not used here.
